hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

Attached to the Implementation Profile https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/otsu-thresholding (implementsProfile), after checking its signature (docs/ATTACHMENTS.md).

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/otsu-thresholding, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

definition: Thresholds a single-band raster into a binary mask using Otsu's method.

assumedFormatGaps.name: raster
assumedFormatGaps.reason: The CWL (GeoLabs/ogc-eo-application-package-hands-on f472585, `otsu.cwl`) declares no `format` on this File, so the processDescription derived by eoap.cct.cwl-to-ogcprocess serves application/octet-stream: the deployment exposes no media type for the GeoTIFF it reads or writes. Closed upstream if the CWL declares `format: ogc:geotiff`.
assumedFormatGaps.evidence: Run record `water-bodies`: the `raster` inputs of node_otsu (norm_diff.tif) are single-band TIFFs with the GeoTIFF tags 33550, 33922, 34735, EPSG:32610 (observed 2026-11-10).

openeoEquivalence.rationale: openEO has no built-in Otsu (automatic histogram) threshold process; the closest primitive, `ogc.openeo.processes.comparison.gt`, only compares against a caller-supplied constant, not a threshold the process computes itself.
